test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution gives Centre the power to take over a state administration on the recommendation of the Governor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 356.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• If a** state government is unable to function in accordance with constitutional provisions,** the Union government may take direct control of the state apparatus under Article 356 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The item was **first used in 1954.** It has also been used in the **Patiala and East Punjab States unions (PEPSU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 124 deals with the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court.** It specifies that there must be a Supreme Court of India composed of a Chief Justice of India and not more than seven other Judges unless Parliament by law mandates a larger number.
 
• Art. **105 states** that, pursuant to the requirements of this constitution and the rules and standing orders governing Parliamentary business, there shall be a Gram Sabha which may exercise such powers and perform such functions at the** village level as the Legislature of a State **may, by law, provide, as per art **243 of the constitution**.
